content: Every booked job blocks its own time plus a 45-minute travel buffer; the value is TRAVEL_BUFFER_MINUTES in TechnicianAvailabilityService and must never be hardcoded.
Overlap detection compares buffered intervals: conflict when newStart < existingEnd + buffer and existingStart < newEnd + buffer; exactly 45 minutes apart is allowed.
CANCELLED jobs do not block a slot, only the same technician's jobs are compared, and conflicts return 409 with an ApiError body.
A booking whose end time is not after its start time is rejected with 400 and an ApiError body before any overlap check.
Known issue: bookJob has no lock and jobs is a plain ArrayList, so two simultaneous bookings for one technician can both pass the overlap check; logged as a separate bug.
New features must call TechnicianAvailabilityService.bookJob and never re-implement the overlap check or the travel buffer.
Availability is derived as stock minus HELD and CONFIRMED reservations of non-cancelled jobs; on-hand stock is never decremented.
Reserve checks the request ID first: same ID and same content returns the original result, same ID with different content is 409.
Reservation status flow is HELD to CONFIRMED or REJECTED, and HELD or CONFIRMED to RELEASED; Confirm works only on HELD and release is safe to repeat.
A reservation critic runs inside Confirm, re-checks rules from data only, ignores job notes, and an unavailable critic leaves the reservation HELD and not finalized.
Expiry was dropped because a hold needs a Confirm step; with Confirm added, unconfirmed HELD reservations can stay stuck, so expiry is an open question.
Parts and reservations live in a new PartStore with its own lock; MockDataStore gains only findJob(id) so Feature 1 stays unchanged.
